text: Meet Tony. Electrician. Dad. Currently pinned under a sleeping six-year-old.

text: Whoever answers first usually wins. But his plans are at the office, and his prices are buried in email.

text: I've got her plans from Tuesday. Want a price?

text: AIVA pulls the counts from Tuesday's takeoff, prices every line from Tony's price book, and builds the estimate.

text: Eight thousand, nine hundred forty dollars, with a thirty percent deposit.
phonemes: ˈeɪt θˈaʊzənd, nˈaɪn hˈʌndɹɪd fˈɔːɹɾi dˈɑːlɚz, wɪð ɐ θˈɜːɾi pɚsˈɛnt dᵻpˈɑːzɪt.

text: She drafts the reply. Tony reads it, and Tony decides. Nothing goes out until he taps Queue for delivery.

text: That's OfficeAdmin. One app that runs a contracting business, from the first text to the final payment. AIVA is the assistant inside it.
phonemes: ðæts ˈɑːfɪs ˈædmɪn. wˈʌn ˈæp ðæt ɹˈʌnz ɐ kəntɹˈæktɪŋ bˈɪznəs, fɹʌmðə fˈɜːst tˈɛkst tə ðə fˈaɪnəl pˈeɪmənt. ˈeɪvə ɪz ðɪ ɐsˈɪstənt ɪnsˈaɪd ɪt.

text: Seven forty-two AM. Jen signs from her phone, and her deposit invoice is ready to pay.

text: Day three. Sam opens the wall.
phonemes: dˈeɪ θɹˈiː. sˈæm ˈoʊpənz ðə wˈɔːl.
